A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable 26-page versions of the same research work, including Appendices A–G. Text extraction and rendered-page comparisons support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original unlearning experiments across fictitious, continual and real-world scenarios in Section 5, with additional results and analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments, including the quantitative comparisons in Table 2 and Appendix E and the generated examples in Appendix G.

M1.justification: The ME+GD and IDK+AP procedures, objectives and components are unchanged. The correction in Section 4.1 does not alter either method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same TOFU tasks, continual-unlearning scenarios, real-world individuals, auxiliary data and five downstream benchmarks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the main and appendix experiments, including the GA, NPO, DPO and IDK combinations and the GD control in Table 10.

E3.justification: The metrics, data partitions, model configurations, training budgets and evaluation procedures in Sections 2.2 and 5, Appendix D and the supplementary experiments are identical.

E4.justification: The continual-unlearning failure analyses, unlearning-strength and question-masking ablations, LoRA comparisons, Forget Quality analysis and generated examples are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including Appendix F's KS-test-based Forget Quality and reported p-values. No run-count, seed or uncertainty-reporting information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings and generated examples are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains ME+GD's model utility of 0.4901 and forget efficacy of 0.9312 in both versions.

T1.justification: Section 4.1 changes Pr(X_F|Y_F) to Pr(Y_F|X_F) and two occurrences of Pr(X_R|Y_R) to Pr(Y_R|X_R), correcting the conditioning direction in its mathematical argument. The method equations and derivations in Appendices B–C are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions concerning evaluation metrics, untargeted entropy maximization and targeted answer preservation.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning hallucinations, excessive refusal, continual-unlearning failures and metric limitations are unchanged. The Section 4.1 correction aligns its symbols with the existing verbal explanation.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware disclosures, evaluation-model information and code/data links remain identical, including Appendix D and the LoRA settings in Appendix E.8.

R1.justification: The citations, bibliography and positioning relative to prior unlearning research are unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v3, 3 March 2025, to v4, 21 May 2025. Apart from the local mathematical corrections, the prose, headings and document organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, display structures and placement are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. The margin-stamp text update does not reorganize the layout.

improvement.justification: v4 corrects reversed conditional probabilities in Section 4.1, making its symbolic explanation consistent with answer prediction given a question. This removes a localized mathematical inconsistency and modestly improves precision; the methods, empirical evidence and appendices remain unchanged.
